mapper.insert: insert into device_statics_info_result(device_code, device_name, device_type, duration, offline_count, normal_day, commission_days, cruise_percent, intact_percent) values (#{deviceCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{duration, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{offlineCount, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{normalDay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commissionDays, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cruisePercent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{intactPercent, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select device_code as deviceCode, device_name as deviceName, device_type as deviceType, duration, offline_count as offLineCount, normal_day as normalDay, commission_days as commissionDays, cruise_percent as cruisePercent, intact_percent as intactPercent from device_statics_info_result where device_code = #{deviceCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select robot_id robotId, robot_name as robotName, robot_num as deviceCode, last_online_time as lastOnlineTime, convert(duration / 60 / 1000, decimal (10, 0)) as duration, off_line_count as offLineCount, commission_date from t_robot_info where robot_id = #{robotId,jdbcType=BIGINT} LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE device_run WHEN 0 THEN commission_days + TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(device_resume_date) ELSE commission_days END AS normal_day FROM device_statics_info_result where device_code = #{deivceCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1

SELECT result.cruise_day as cruise_day, result.commission_days as commission_days, convert(result.cruise_day / result.commission_days * 100, decimal (15, 3)) AS cruise_rate FROM ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT TO_DAYS(updr.cruise_time)) AS cruise_day, TO_DAYS( NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.commission_date) + 1 AS commission_days FROM t_robot_info tr LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection tri ON tr.robot_id = tri.robot_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance tcpi ON tri.inspection_id = tcpi.cruise_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result updr ON updr.instance_id = tcpi.instance_id WHERE tri.robot_id = #{robotId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND updr.cruise_time IS NOT NULL AND tr.commission_date <= updr.`createtime` ) result

SELECT result.cruise_day as cruise_day, result.commission_days as commission_days, convert(result.cruise_day / result.commission_days * 100, decimal (15, 3)) AS cruise_rate FROM ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT TO_DAYS(updr.cruise_time)) AS cruise_day, TO_DAYS( NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tc.commission_date) + 1 AS commission_days FROM t_camera_info tc LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset tcp ON tc.camera_id = tcp.camera_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance tcpi ON tcp.preset_id = tcpi.cruise_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result updr ON updr.instance_id = tcpi.instance_id WHERE tc.camera_id = #{cameraId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND updr.cruise_time IS NOT NULL and updr.cruise_time > tc.commission_date ) result

SELECT device_code as deviceCode, device_name as deviceName, device_type as deviceType, duration, offline_count as offLineCount, normal_day as normalDay, commission_days as commissionDays, cruise_percent as cruisePercent, intact_percent as intactPercent from device_statics_info_result WHERE device_type = #{type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT device_code as deviceCode, device_name as deviceName, device_type as deviceType, duration, offline_count as offLineCount, normal_day as normalDay, commission_days as commissionDays, cruise_percent as cruisePercent, intact_percent as intactPercent from device_statics_info_result WHERE device_type = 1

SELECT a.robot_id robotId, a.robot_name AS robotName, a.robot_num AS deviceCode, a.last_online_time AS lastOnlineTime, IFNULL( CONCAT( CONVERT ( a.duration / 60 / 1000, DECIMAL (10, 0) ), '分钟' ), 0 ) AS duration, a.off_line_count AS offLineCount, a.commission_date, CASE b.device_run WHEN 0 THEN b.commission_days + TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(b.device_resume_date) ELSE b.commission_days END AS normal_day FROM t_robot_info a LEFT JOIN device_statics_info_result b ON a.robot_num = b.device_code where 1=1 and a.robot_id IN #{robotId}
LIMIT #{startIndex},#{endIndex}
